content_blocks.label: clause_1._Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: I give, devise, and bequeath all my personal property to my beloved wife, Maryanne K. Longworth, hereinafter referred to as the 'Beneficiary'.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Real_Property
content_blocks.text: I give, devise, and bequeath my real property located at 789 Elm Street, Pineville City, State of Novacorp, to my son, Thomas J. Longworth, hereinafter referred to as the 'Heir'.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Executor
content_blocks.text: I appoint my daughter, Jane E. Longworth, as the Executor of my Estate.
